app.name: Haru
app.tagline: Your whole trip, ready in one day

home.heroTitle: Get your whole trip ready in one day
home.heroSub: Itinerary, flights, stays, weather and local deals — all sorted today, in one place.
home.noTrips: No trips yet. Start with your first one.

setup.title: New trip
setup.notesPh: e.g. vegetarian, stroller, no shopping, Gyeongbokgung, late start
setup.errGeneric: We couldn't build the itinerary. Please try again.
setup.destSearch: Search a city or country (e.g. Tokyo, Paris)
setup.cityHint: Up to {n} cities, in travel order.
setup.interestsHint: Pick as many as you like
setup.stayQ: Will you change hotels during the trip? (e.g. 2 nights in one place, 2 in another)

setup.stayNeed: You can split stays on trips of 2 nights or more.
setup.errStays: Nights per stay must add up to the total nights.
setup.errServer: Could not save to the server (error {code}). Please check the server setup.

itin.affiliateDisclosure: Booking links are affiliate links. We may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
itin.chatCta: Ask the concierge about this day
itin.error: This trip has no itinerary yet.
itin.aiNotice: Itinerary generated by AI. Check opening hours before you go.

chat.title: Concierge
chat.placeholder: Ask about flights, hotels, transport, food…
chat.hello: Hi! I'm Haru, your travel concierge. Ask me about flights, hotels, getting around, food or useful local phrases.
chat.error: The concierge is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
chat.limit: You've reached today's message limit. It resets tomorrow.
chat.disclosure: AI-generated answers may contain mistakes. Verify prices and hours.

deals.title: Deals
deals.sub: Offers from local businesses. Sponsored listings are marked.

flights.title: Flights
flights.sub: Compare fares and book with trusted partners.
flights.errSame: Departure and arrival airports must differ.
flights.error: Couldn't load fares. Please try again.
flights.limit: You've reached today's search limit. Try again tomorrow.
flights.noticeSample: Sample fares for demo — not live prices. The final price is shown on the partner site.
flights.noticeLive: Recent fares found by partners in the last 48 hours. Prices and seats change; the final price is shown on the partner site.
flights.cabinNote: {cabin} fares cannot be looked up in the app. Check the same search on the sites below.
flights.fareNote: Recently found one-way {cabin} fares, shown separately for each direction. A round-trip ticket may be priced differently. Check flight numbers and times on the booking site.

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.error: Couldn't load hotels. Please try again.
hotels.unsupported: A live hotel list isn't available for this city yet. Search directly on our partners:
hotels.noticeSample: Sample hotels and prices for demo — not real listings. Search the partner sites for actual availability.
hotels.noticeLive: Prices from partners, per room per night, before taxes and fees. Final price on the partner site.
hotels.sampleTop: These are sample listings for testing, so no hotel with these names exists. The button opens real hotel results for the same area and dates.

deals2.title: Business class deals
deals2.sub: Last-minute and discounted business fares from your airport, biggest savings first.
deals2.bannerSub: Last-minute business fares, sorted by discount
deals2.empty: No business deals in this window. Try a longer period or another airport.
deals2.noticeSample: Sample deals for demo — not live prices. Discounts are estimated against typical business fares for the route.
deals2.noticeLive: Business fares found by partners recently. Discounts are estimated against typical fares for the route; seats are limited and prices change — the final price is on the partner site.
deals2.homeEmpty: No deals to show right now.

weather.rainPlan: Rain or snow is likely and this day is mostly outdoors. Line up an indoor backup.
weather.notice: Weather: forecast within 16 days of today, otherwise typical conditions (average of the same dates over the past 3 years). Check again before you leave. Data: Open-Meteo.com
weather.noticeSample: Sample weather for testing — not a real forecast.

prep.title: Trip ready in one day
prep.essentialsSub: Passport validity · entry rules · currency · roaming/eSIM · travel insurance

req.title: Your requests
req.noDetail: This itinerary has no record of how requests were applied. Tap Regenerate to see it.
req.sampleNote: Sample mode only reads keywords. The live service has the AI read and apply the full sentence.

report.title: Trip report
report.costNote: Sum of the admission and meal costs listed in the itinerary. Flights and hotels are not included and actual prices may differ.

gear.title: Travel gear
gear.sub: Picked for this trip’s weather, destination and flight length.
gear.disclosure: Shopping links may be affiliate links; we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. These are product types, not specific products — check price and stock at the store.

why.weather_umbrella: Rain is likely on some days
why.weather_snow: Snow is likely on some days
why.weather_layers: Big swing between day and night
why.abroad: Different plugs and mobile networks abroad
why.flight: Carry-on only — check the capacity limit
why.always: Maps and photos drain your battery all day
why.long: Five days or more means more luggage

airport.title: Airport wait guide
airport.sub: What to do with the time you have before boarding.
airport.openSub: Departing {from} · make use of the wait
airport.loungeNote: Lounge locations, hours and entry rules change often. Check your card or airline benefits and the airport’s official guide.
airport.hlNote: Check the airport’s official guide for current hours and availability.
airport.ask: Ask the concierge about this airport
airport.none: This trip does not need a flight

tip.gate: Find your gate and boarding time first, then stay nearby
tip.water: Buy water and a snack after security
tip.charge: Charge your phone and power bank
tip.meal: Have a meal. Head to the gate 40 minutes before boarding
tip.lounge: Use a lounge (card or airline benefits, or a day pass)
tip.dutyfree: Collect duty-free pre-orders and browse the shops
tip.shower: Take a shower (in a lounge or airport facilities)
tip.walk: Visit the observation deck, exhibits or gardens
tip.nap: Rest in a nap zone or capsule hotel
tip.transitTour: If the airport runs transit tours, sign up (check entry rules)

ICN.1: Free transit tours for layover passengers

SIN.1: The indoor waterfall at Jewel Changi
SIN.3: Free city tour for layovers of 5.5 hours or more

ads.slot: Banner ad space · real ads appear in the app

meals.title: Today’s meals
meals.sampleNote: Sample mode suggests typical local dishes instead of restaurants. The live service recommends restaurants near your route for that day.

reserve.title: How to book a restaurant
reserve.apps: Booking services people use in this country
reserve.note: Haru does not make reservations for you. Check availability and terms with each service.

step.need: First check whether you need a booking. Popular places, dinners and weekends usually do; markets and street food do not.
step.app: Search the restaurant name on one of the services below, then pick the date, time and party size.
step.hotel: If the app does not work, ask your hotel front desk to call for you, or phone the number shown on the map.
step.tell: When you book, say how many people, whether children are coming, and any vegetarian or allergy needs.
step.cancel: Cancel if you cannot go. Some restaurants take a deposit or charge a no-show fee.

outfit.label: What to wear
outfit.o20: Light long sleeves or a shirt
outfit.o5: Coat with thermals and a scarf
outfit.o0: Padded coat, gloves, scarf and hat
outfit.extra: Mornings and evenings are much cooler — bring one more layer

tips.title: Country tips
tips.sub: Good to know before you arrive.
tips.adapterNeed: Different from your home plugs — bring an adapter.
tips.adapterOk: Your home plugs fit as they are.
tips.voltNote: The voltage differs. Check that chargers and hair dryers are dual-voltage (100–240V).

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.service: A service charge is often included, so no extra tip is needed.
tipping.optional: Not required; leave small change for good service.
tipping.expected: Tipping is effectively required at restaurants and in taxis (usually 15–20%).

pay.label: Payment
pay.cash: Many shops are cash only — carry local currency.
pay.mobile: Mobile payment (Alipay, WeChat Pay) dominates. Link a card in the app before you go.

tips.unknown: No data for this country yet. Ask the concierge.
tips.note: General guidance that can vary by region and season. Always confirm entry rules with official government sources.

map.title: Map & route
map.sub: The order of your stops and the distance between them. Works without internet.
map.total: About {min} min of travel today · {km} km
map.none: No places to show on the map
map.est: Travel times are estimates from straight-line distance. Check the real route in a map app.
map.custom: {n} places you added yourself are left off the map because their location is unknown.

issue.tooMany: {n} stops is a lot. At this pace, {max} or fewer per day works better.
issue.longLeg: {from} → {to} is a long trip ({km} km, about {min} min).
issue.longDay: About {min} min ({km} km) just getting around. Drop a stop or group nearby places.
issue.overlap: You are {min} min short between {from} and {to}.
issue.backtrack: You visit {area} twice. Grouping it saves travel.

edit.title: Edit itinerary
edit.sub: Reorder stops, move them to another day, or add any place you like.
edit.pasteHelp: Paste a list of places copied from a blog or your notes. One place per line.
edit.pastePh:
e.g.
1. Gyeongbokgung
2. Tongin Market
3. Bukchon Hanok Village

ledger.title: Expenses & split
ledger.sub: Log what you spend and see who owes whom.
ledger.local: Expenses are stored on this device only.

packing.title: Packing list
packing.sub: The basics plus items that fit this trip’s weather and destination.

talk.title: Traveler talk
talk.sub: Swap on-the-ground news with others heading to the same place.
talk.ph: Share local news or ask a question (300 characters)
talk.reported: Reported. You will no longer see this post.
talk.none: No posts yet. Be the first.

err.contact: Phone numbers and messenger IDs are not allowed.
err.rate: Please wait a moment (3 posts per minute).
err.failed: Could not post. Please try again.

talk.rules: Be respectful. No ads, contact swapping or companion-seeking posts. Other travelers’ posts are personal opinions, not information verified by Haru.
talk.sampleNote: In the test bed you see example posts, and your own posts stay on your device. In the live service they are shared with travelers to the same place.

share.copied: Share code copied. Send it to your travel companions.
share.import_: Import a trip from a share code
share.importPh: Paste the code starting with HARU1:
share.bad: Could not read the code. Make sure you copied all of it.
share.help: Your companion pastes the code into “Import a trip from a share code” on the home screen to save a copy of the same itinerary.

reward.title: You have used today’s free turns
reward.regenBody: Rebuilding the itinerary is free {free} time a day. Watch an ad to rebuild {n} more time.
reward.chatBody: You can ask {free} questions a day for free. Watch an ad to ask {n} more.
reward.maxed: No more available today. Please come back tomorrow.
reward.failed: The ad could not be loaded. Please try again shortly.
reward.previewNote: The test bed shows this screen instead of a real ad. The app plays a video ad.
